Ond's third beta makes installing an update yourself clearer.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.3-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.3-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on x86_64, glibc 2.39 or newer |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.3-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, same requirements |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.3-windows-x86_64.zip` | Windows 10 and 11 |

The `.minisig` files are signatures. Ond checks a download against them before it installs an update.

### What's new

- A newer version in Settings › About now offers **Install**, which downloads and installs it inside Ond, and **Get from GitHub**, which opens its release page. Before, the button opened GitHub even when Ond could install the update itself.
- A copy that can't install itself, such as one run from the dmg, offers only Get from GitHub and says why.

### Please report

If an update doesn't install, Settings › About says why. Please report it with your OS, how you installed Ond, and that message.
